svg.text: Issuing a non-eID Matura-Zeugnis credential: proposed flow
DIDAS proposal for discussion. The student is identified with the school account, not the e-ID. The governing authority sets the rules for the credential and keeps the list of authoritative issuers.
1 Governance set-up for the use case / ecosystem (once)
Matura certificates are recognised by the WBF and the EDK on cantonal application to the SMK (MAV Art. 33-34).
The authoritative issuer list and the governance framework for the credential are a DIDAS proposal; who runs them is not decided.
Open: can a credential carry the legal effect of the certificate, given the signature requirement in MAV Art. 27?
Which grades does the credential show by default? At admission, the university may additionally ask for the e-ID to bind the Matura to the person.
